neuroinclusive: Small groups that follow a familiar, predictable structure. Our Game Educators have experience working with neurodivergent children. Everyone can be themselves and take part at their own pace.
beginner: No previous gaming experience is required. Our Game Educators are there to provide hands-on guidance when needed and help each participant join in at their own level. You can join even if the game is completely new to you.
advanced: For children who already know the basics of the game and are ready to take their skills further. More challenging projects and a group that can keep up with them.
